title: Evaluator/review code is duplicated and the domain/service boundary is weak

original_titles.title: God routers: business logic, validation and raw SQL all inline; no service layer
Worker/domain module imports private helpers from a router (layering inversion)
Nine admin endpoints take untyped body: dict with hand-rolled validation
ORM model layer (~740 lines) is dead code duplicating the SQL schema
Frontend hand-copies the backend state machines
Function-level inline imports scattered across the backend
Backend runtime dependencies are lower-bound only with no lockfile
Tooling and structure deviations: no mypy --strict, single uvicorn (no Gunicorn workers), sync psycopg (no asyncpg), no lockfile, no boundaries CI
Challenge fixtures: intentional parallel implementations with manual parity maintenance
Backend dependencies not hash-pinned; no lockfile or scanning evidence

problem: Core business logic, raw SQL and validation remain concentrated in very large routers. Evaluator and evaluator_level duplicate award/review flow; matching.decide and decide_multi share duplicated scoring logic; some worker/domain modules import private router helpers. There is no strict backend type-check or dependency lockfile in the original audit scope.
impact: Changes to high-churn modules have large regression/merge-conflict risk, policy is difficult to unit test without HTTP+DB, and dependency resolution can drift between builds.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Extract pure domain services for stage lifecycle, team/participant lifecycle, GT authoring, scoring/review application, rescore and exports. Routers should validate/authorize, call services and serialize responses.
Create one evaluator application service that handles single-round and four-level submissions through strategy/config adapters; eliminate duplicated award/review code.
Create one matcher core with explicit single/multi-location feature extraction and shared thresholds. Pin the matcher version in each evaluation record.
Replace private router-helper imports with service/module dependencies and replace dynamic __import__ patterns with normal imports.
Add strict typing in controlled increments (mypy/pyright or pyright-like checker) and generate a fully pinned dependency lockfile with vulnerability scanning.

acceptance_criteria: Routers contain no scoring/ledger business logic.
Single and four-level evaluators share deterministic core.
Type checking and dependency audit run in CI.
A service-layer test can exercise domain rules without FastAPI request objects.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.
